title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Fizzy Cherry
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kits Only Refresh your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit with the Fizzy Cherry Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. This convenient replacement pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid in a punchy Cherry flavour with a subtle effervescent twist. Fizzy Cherry delivers bold and juicy Cherry notes lifted with a light effervescence that adds a playful edge to the flavour. Smooth, sweet and ever-so-slightly tangy, it’s an ideal choice for vapers who enjoy a rich, fruity vape with a touch of sherbet or soda sparkle. Each pod and refill pack is designed exclusively for the Dojo Blast 10K device and offers up to 10,000 puffs (device total), powered by Vaporesso's dual mesh coil and COREX 2.0 technology. The transparent pod design makes it easy to track your e-liquid levels, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures steady coil saturation for consistently excellent flavour.
